title: NOTICE - COURT DIRECTION - Time Rescheduled - PILs
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: 12/09/2024 Sd/-

FULL TEXT:
N O T I C E
As directed by the Hon’ble the First Court (Coram:
Hon’ble the Chief Justice Mrs. Justice Sunita Agarwal and
Hon’ble Mr. Justice Pranav Trivedi), Matters Listed at Sr
Nos. 51 to 55 of the “Daily Board” dated 13th September,
2024, under the caption “Urgent Admission at 12:30 PM”,
shall be taken up at 11:00 AM, peremptorily.
Concerned Learned Senior Advocates/ Advocates/ Counsels
appearing in the said matters may kindly take note of this
direction of the Hon’ble Court.
By Order of the Hon’ble Court,
Date: 12/09/2024 Sd/-
Time: 06:10 PM (Naval N Gajjar)
Court Master
